source_sha_relation: execution source is an ancestor of the audit HEAD

timeline.evidence: The runner enters model loading, audit, partition digest and then the PETSc assembler before the observed long-running phase.
PetscTET4Assembler creates an AIJ matrix and calls matrix.setUp() before the element insertion loop.
All eight Python ranks were runnable and CPU-active; the runner had not reached matrix.assemble().
The runner calls RHS construction and ksp.setUp() only after PetscTET4Assembler.assemble() returns.

termination.forensic_stop_result: container stopped and removed; no raw result was written

process_observations.log_output: EMPTY; runner writes the JSON only after completion

memory_observations.last_observed_container_rss: approximately 4.02 GiB from docker top; not a peak measurement
memory_observations.previous_partial_observation: approximately 9.9 GiB plateau was observed during monitoring; no persisted time series

scaling_analysis.interpretation: Linear DOF/element growth of about 1.67 does not by itself explain the observed multi-hour AIJ insertion phase. The 3M total includes solve and post while the 5M observation is pre-readiness, so the ratios are diagnostic rather than an apples-to-apples benchmark. The source path performs a Python loop and one PETSc setValues call per element, making sparse insertion and communication overhead plausible contributors; no counter isolates them.
scaling_analysis.eta_to_pc_ready: NOT_ESTIMABLE; no element/chunk progress counter and no completed assembly record

decision.c1_candidate: The AIJ insertion path is a diagnostic lead, not a confirmed conditional-gate trigger.

retry_plan.checkpoint_interpretation: Audit progress and resource telemetry at the 2x reference point; elapsed time alone must not be converted into RESOURCE_LIMITED without a completed run or a measured resource ceiling.
retry_plan.pre_run_policy_clarification_required: The existing guard text says to stop at 2x; before a longer retry, Owner must explicitly treat that point as a diagnostic checkpoint while retaining the five-hour hard ceiling.
retry_plan.memory_stop_limit: The existing Docker cgroup limit of 50458099712 bytes; no new acceptance threshold is introduced.
stop_conditions: Docker cgroup memory limit or OOM signal
all-rank CPU inactivity with no counter advancement
no observable assembly progress for a declared sampling interval
metrics_to_capture_every_60_seconds: elements and chunks completed per rank
CPU time and CPU percent per rank
current and peak RSS per rank
cgroup memory events and host swap pressure
MPI rank liveness and error state

historical_interpretation.preserved_observation: The previous resource-guard record still documents the 2x budget overrun and the absence of a completed raw record; its causal classification is superseded because the process was manually interrupted and remained alive.

claim_boundary: Deterministic 5M workload generation and preflight are proved. AIJ insertion was active but incomplete; no 5M Bronze readiness, PC_READY, 5M solve, performance or universal capacity claim is made.
